scoring_justification: T1 recompute from raw simulation traces is infeasible without the per-run data; scoring the averaged modulus values against paper-reported references with tolerance and enforcing required trends.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold Young's modulus values for each condition and structural trend thresholds
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from Figs 2, 3, 4 and text of the paper (values: L10=0.7, L20=0.9, L40=1.1, L80=1.1, T100=0.95, T500=1.1, D5=1.1, D10=0.97, D20=0.93 TPa; trends from qualitative descriptions).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct read of paper figures and statements.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values reported in the publication, ensuring the reproduction target matches the paper's findings.

schema.description: Each row is a condition identifier and its average Young's modulus in TPa.

outputs.description: The final averaged Young's modulus values for all 11 conditions. The hidden checker compares these values to paper-reported gold references and enforces required trends.

output_contract.notes: The evidence file per_run_Y.json is not scored; it is only for documentation of the simulation work. The agent must run all MD simulations for the 11 conditions (size, temperature, disorder) as described in the steps.

size_increase.description: Y(L=40) > Y(L=10) by at least 0.1 TPa

disorder_decrease.description: Y(D20%) < Y(D0%) by at least 0.05 TPa
